text:
Ash: Midday async — quick gap analysis for synthia-largeq onboarding. Local eval: +2% accuracy drop on span-completion tests vs baseline. Trying to capture what happened and hand off if I have to step away.

Ash: What I did: ran full eval harness on cpu/gpu, compared tokenization diffs, checked KV-warmup heatmaps. Pushed a small quant-config tweak (PR 4827).

Ash: Blockers: intermittent tokenization length mismatch for Spanish prompts (~1% of cases). Some examples produce extra byte-level token; looks like tokenizer edge-case on long ctx. Also nightly batch job OOM'd once during longctx sampling.

Sophia: Noted. Can you paste a failing tokenization example? I can run tokenizer unit tests quickly.

Ash: Sure — paste below:
```
input: "¿Cómo se llama la capital de Nueva España que..."
expected tokens len: 128
observed tokens len: 129
token diff: [0xA3, 0x2F]  // weird multibyte char split
```

Noah: That looks like a utf-8 grapheme split; we saw similar with long spanish prompts in lv2 earlier. Quick workaround: run normalizer pre-step `text.encode('utf-8', 'replace').decode()` — not ideal but can reduce failures for now.

Maria: Re: OOM — which machine type? dedicated or CI runner?

Ash: CI runner (g4dn-like); autoscaling doesn't cover the nightly job since it's a one-off. I throttled batch size from 32->16 and it finished. I think default batch/seq config for longctx test is too aggressive.

Jen: Sounds like two workstreams: tokenizer normalization fix + eval harness config. I'm happy to pick up tokenizer unit tests and add a regression case. Assigning to me unless someone else already on it.

Ash: Thanks Jen — assigning. Also, putting a note in PR 4827: quant tweak gave small perf gain but didn't address span drop.

Sophia: Can we get a quick canary run on Dedicated with the quant tweak + tokenizer normalizer? I can spin one up for 1hr. Want to see latency + quality changes before merging.

Ash: Yes please. Canary run checklist: 1) run eval-harness with 5k Spanish and English span tests, 2) dump tokenization mismatches to S3, 3) collect latency p95/p99.

EvalBot: Canary scheduled (job id: cb-20231109-17), start ETA ~10m. Will post results in thread when done.

Noah: Quick ask — does anyone have bandwidth for a fast CR on PR 4832 (small eval harness logging) ? It's needed to capture mismatch traces to S3.

Sophia: I can review in ~30m. Leave a note in PR.

Ash: FYI — small grep I ran showed mismatches concentrated on two token ids. Added a short patch to map them to safe token in fallback path. Not ideal but can be toggled via config: `--tokenizer-fallback=on`

Jen: I'll add unit tests for those two token ids and a tiny integration to reproduce locally. ETA EOD for tests + PR.

Ash: Today: document findings in onboarding ticket, follow up on Canary, and pair with Sophia for the dedicated run. If Canary looks good, we'll roll the quant tweak behind a flag then schedule a small canary rollout.

Maria: Heads-up for ops: if canary triggers higher mem, please OOM alert me and I'll scale runner.

EvalBot: Canary complete — summary: quality delta: -0.6% span accuracy (w/ quant tweak), token mismatch rate: 0.9% -> 0.2% (with tokenizer fallback ON), p95 latency +3ms, p99 +18ms. Full artifact: s3://redwood-eval/cb-20231109-17/report.json

Ash: Thanks EvalBot. Looks like fallback helps a lot for token mismatch but quant tweak still has a small quality regression. We should keep quant tweak behind a flag and run A/B with traffic routing on a small slice.

Sophia: Agreed. I'll set up an A/B canary in the console for 5% traffic for 2 hours with automatic rollback on quality regression >1%.

Noah: CR ping: PR 4832 (logging) -> @Sophia assigned. PR 4827 (quant tweak) -> @Ash + @Jen for tests.

Jen: Picking up tokenizer tests now. Will post a draft PR with reproducer.

Ash: Thanks all. If we don't get a rollback, tomorrow morning I'll start the canary roll forward. If rollback happens, I'll open a follow-up tracing ticket.

Sophia: One more note — add a quick eval that samples from customer-like prompts (not just synthetic spans). We saw differences there before.

Ash: Good call — adding that to the canary checklist.

Maria: Ok — will monitor infra and standby. :eyes:

Ash: End of midday update. Short and messy — feel free to ping me if anything blocks while I'm AFK later.

Jen: Thanks — will update PRs and post links here. :thumbsup:
